sentences.en: The trees are barren or bear only small fruit.
sentences.zh: 这些树要么果实稀少，要么完全不结果。

sentences.en: The plundering of this land has left it barren and infertile.
sentences.zh: 这片土地被掠夺后变得贫瘠而不复肥沃。

sentences.en: It seems as if the barren fields are shivering with cold.
sentences.zh: 荒芜的土地似乎在寒风中瑟瑟发抖。

senses.zh: 贫瘠的；不结果实的；不孕的
